_FLOW: Complete index of mindcontrolpoems.blogspot.com, the archive's primary publication surface. Built 2026-08-23 by exhaustive start-index pagination of the Blogger summary feed, verified against the feed's own declared total. EXISTS SO THAT ABSENCE CAN BE ASSERTED HONESTLY: the archival search protocol says check the archive before claiming a record does not exist, and until this index the blog was not searchable that way. A registry search is not an archive search.
method: start-index pagination, 34 entries per response (Blogger response-size cap; max-results is not honoured above that). Completeness verified against openSearch:totalResults.
prior_index: data/batch-axn-assignment.json — 871 AXN-assigned works, all with blog_url, covering 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-19. Every one of its URLs resolves in this harvest; zero orphans.
known_limits: excerpt is the feed summary, truncated at 300 characters, not the post body
no word counts: the summary feed does not carry full content, and fetching 2,939 bodies is a separate run
post_id is the Blogger entry id tail, not an archive identifier
